searchText: Hey just wanted to share something we've been working on - this is a unified specification of all the EOF EIPs. Should be a much easier format for implementers and those curious about EOF! https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/eof1-unified-specification <@425279588009246720> <@275684146658148352> <@425274498732916736> Re. EIP-4750. IMO "inout" or "signature" is a better name for the new section than "type". To my mind type is more immediately associated with things like uint64 or float or complex. That's a good point, `signature` sounds like a good alternative. But then again `signature` could be confused with cryptographic signature 😦 ^ was just typing this I have avoided using `signature` in the geth impl because of this parameters I have used `Annotation` / `TypeAnnotation` <@543900561460822016> > for each reachable instruction, data stack height is the same for all possible code paths going through the instruction > * _(There’s a pending change proposal for removing this requirement)_ I've lost track. What PR is this? This is a very important requirement -- I'm not sure you can even validate code that doesn't meet it. sorry, this was from a previous validation bullet that was removed and I think that child bullet didn’t get removed the stack is still required to be the same for all possible code paths Good, thanks. hi all, I posted this on ethereum magicians but posting it here too: I’m implementing tests for EIP-3860 on the python tests repository, and I’m having trouble understanding point 4 here: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-3860.md#rules It seems like the hashing costs for CREATE2 are charged even when the initcode exceeds the max length, which doesn’t make much sense to me since there should be no hashing performed at all. Is this the correct behavior or should the hashing costs not be charged in this case? I’m currently testing using latest version here: https://github.com/ewasm/go-ethereum/tree/eip-3860 We should have a couple EOF syncs before Jan 5! Could we plan for Dec 15 and Dec 29 @ 1600 UTC? Pls respond 👍 or 👎 also open to other suggestions

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content:
hi all, I posted this on ethereum magicians but posting it here too:

I’m implementing tests for EIP-3860 on the python tests repository, and I’m having trouble understanding point 4 here: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/EIPS/eip-3860.md#rules

It seems like the hashing costs for CREATE2 are charged even when the initcode exceeds the max length, which doesn’t make much sense to me since there should be no hashing performed at all.

Is this the correct behavior or should the hashing costs not be charged in this case?

I’m currently testing using latest version here: https://github.com/ewasm/go-ethereum/tree/eip-3860
